title: The Yellow Gate
notes: The sliding gate and the long white wall
address: Bosques de las Lomas, Mexico City

cover.alt: The yellow gate in the white street wall
cover.caption: The street facade.

detail.intro: From the street the house is a single low wall with two openings: a narrow white door for people and the wide yellow gate for cars. The gate slides rather than swings, so the wall is never broken. The yellow is the only colour on the street.

blocks.html: A thin concrete lintel runs the full length of the wall and carries a hedge of vines, bougainvillea and trumpet flowers that has grown over it for decades. Barragán thought of the garden as a room without a roof; here the planting is left to cover the architecture until, from outside, the house reads as a hedge with a yellow door in it.
